home_about_p1: Kynseed is a 2D pixel art life simulation sandbox RPG developed by PixelCount Studios, a team of former Lionhead Studios developers who created the Fable series. Players control a mystical Kynseed (a magical acorn) that grows into a family tree reflecting their choices across generations.
home_about_p2: Unlike typical farming games, Kynseed features a unique life cycle system where all characters age and eventually die, including your pets. When you pass away, your children inherit your skills, property, and relationships, continuing your legacy in a new generation.
home_cta_description: Build your farm, forge relationships, and create a multigenerational story that will be remembered in Kynseed's world.
faq_whatIsKynseed_answer: Kynseed is a 2D pixel art life simulation RPG developed by former Fable developers. Shape a multigenerational legacy by farming, running businesses, building relationships and passing your skills to your children.
faq_lifeCycle: How does the life cycle work?
faq_lifeCycle_answer: All characters in Kynseed age and eventually die, including your pets. When your character dies, you continue as your child who inherits your skills, property, and relationships, allowing you to build a multigenerational legacy.
faq_combatSystem_answer: Kynseed features three combat styles: Melee (swords, axes), Ranged (bows), and Magic (staffs). Each style has its own skill tree, equipment options and playstyle.
faq_businessTypes_answer: You can run four types of businesses: Taverns (serve food and drinks), Apothecaries (brew potions), Blacksmiths (craft weapons and armor), and Goods Stores (sell farm produce and items).
faq_familyLegacy_answer: When your character dies, you choose one of your children to continue. They inherit your skills, property, relationships, and some of your personality traits, letting you build on your previous generation's achievements.
faq_dungeons_answer: Kynseed features various dungeons including caves, abandoned mines, forest dungeons and ancient ruins. Each dungeon has unique enemies, loot tables and boss encounters.

privacyPolicy_intro: Kynseed Wiki ("we", "us") is a fan-made wiki. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.
privacyPolicy_infoCollect_p1: We collect minimal personal information. The only data processed is what is needed to serve you the site and understand its usage.
privacyPolicy_infoCollect_auto: Automatically collected data: your IP address, browser type, pages visited and referral source, collected via analytics.
privacyPolicy_infoCollect_cookies: Cookies: we use cookies for theme preferences and analytics.
privacyPolicy_infoCollect_noPersonal: We do not collect your name, email address, or other contact details unless you contact us directly.
privacyPolicy_howUse_p1: We use the information we collect to operate and improve the wiki, understand which guides are popular, and fix technical issues.
privacyPolicy_howUse_analytics: Analytics: aggregated, anonymized usage statistics to see which content performs best.
privacyPolicy_howUse_performance: Performance: monitoring to detect and fix errors, outages and performance issues.
privacyPolicy_howUse_preferences: Preferences: remembering your theme (dark/light/system) and locale.
privacyPolicy_dataRights_p1: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data.
privacyPolicy_dataRights_optOut: Opt out of analytics: use your browser's Do Not Track setting or a privacy extension.
privacyPolicy_dataRights_cookies: Control cookies: most browsers let you block or delete cookies.
privacyPolicy_dataRights_contact: Contact us at any time to exercise your rights.
privacyPolicy_thirdParty_p1: We use a small number of third-party services to run and measure the wiki.
privacyPolicy_thirdParty_ga: Google Analytics: measures site usage. Google's privacy policy governs its data handling.
privacyPolicy_thirdParty_steam: Steam: links to the game's official Steam page. Valve's terms and privacy policy apply on their platform.
privacyPolicy_thirdParty_discord: Discord: community links to the official Kynseed Discord server if available.
privacyPolicy_security_p1: We take reasonable measures to protect the wiki and its data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacyPolicy_children_p1: The wiki does not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us personal data, contact us and we will remove it.
privacyPolicy_changes_p1: We may update this policy from time to time. We will post any changes on this page with an updated date.
privacyPolicy_contact_p1: If you have questions about this privacy policy, reach out through our community channels.

category_advantages_guides: The guides category provides a clear path from your first day in Thornborough to becoming a seasoned adventurer. Each guide is written around actual game systems.
category_weaknesses_guides: The main challenge with guides is that game updates can change mechanics. Controls and basic systems are usually stable, but some details may change after major updates.

category_qt_guides_0: Always read the beginner guide before your first day in Thornborough. Understanding the life cycle system early will help you plan your legacy across generations.
category_qt_guides_1: Start farming early. Crops provide essential income for businesses, combat gear and family expenses. Taking time to learn seasonal planting schedules pays off.
category_qt_guides_2: Build relationships with NPCs as early as possible. Gift preferences, daily schedules and personality traits all matter for relationship progression.

category_intro_combat: Combat in Kynseed features three distinct styles: Melee (swords, axes), Ranged (bows), and Magic (staffs). Each style has unique skill trees and equipment options for different playstyles.
category_mechanics_combat: Combat skill trees cover attack power, defense, special abilities and elemental damage. Balance offensive skills with survivability for effective dungeon runs.
category_advantages_combat: Combat guides help you choose the right style for your playstyle and provide strategies for challenging encounters. Well-prepared players can handle any dungeon.
category_weaknesses_combat: Combat balance can shift with updates. Some weapons and skills may become more or less effective after patches.
category_qt_combat_0: Choose your combat style early based on your preferred playstyle. Melee is straightforward, ranged requires positioning, and magic offers crowd control.
category_qt_combat_1: Invest in defensive skills alongside offensive ones. High damage means nothing if you die quickly in dungeons.
category_qt_combat_2: Check enemy weaknesses before entering dungeons. Some enemies are vulnerable to specific damage types.

category_cards_farming_1_subtitle: Raise chickens, cows, sheep and more for income and resources.

category_intro_farming: Farming is the foundation of Kynseed's economy. Plant seasonal crops, raise animals and optimize your farm layout for maximum profit across the four seasons.
category_mechanics_farming: Crops have specific planting and harvest windows based on season. Animals produce resources daily and can be bred for better offspring. Fertilizers improve crop quality.
category_advantages_farming: Farming provides reliable income for purchasing equipment, funding businesses and supporting your family. Well-managed farms generate significant wealth.
category_weaknesses_farming: Farming is seasonal - winter has limited options. Plan ahead and save enough resources to survive the slower winter months.
category_qt_farming_0: Start with easy crops like wheat in spring. Build up capital before attempting higher-profit but riskier crops.
category_qt_farming_1: Save money from farming to invest in businesses. A good farm funds your entire operation.
category_qt_farming_2: Keep some animals for personal use. Eggs and milk provide useful resources for cooking and crafting.

category_cards_business_1_subtitle: Brew potions and sell medicinal items for profit.
category_cards_business_2_subtitle: Craft weapons and armor for adventurers and fighters.
category_cards_business_3_subtitle: Sell farm produce and crafted items directly to customers.
category_intro_business: Run profitable businesses in Kynseed including taverns, apothecaries, blacksmiths and goods stores. Each business type requires different skills and investment levels.
category_mechanics_business: Businesses have daily operating costs, customer flow based on location, and recipes that affect profit margins. Reputation grows with consistent quality service.
category_advantages_business: Well-run businesses generate substantial passive income. Diversifying across multiple business types reduces risk and maximizes profit potential.
category_weaknesses_business: Businesses require initial capital investment and ongoing management. Poor location or low-quality products lead to customer loss.
category_qt_business_0: Start with a goods store or tavern before investing in expensive businesses like apothecaries.
category_qt_business_1: Location matters - businesses near town centers attract more customers.
category_qt_business_2: Quality recipes generate repeat customers and better tips.

category_intro_relationships: Build meaningful relationships with NPCs in Thornborough. Find love, start a family and create a multigenerational legacy that spans across playthroughs.
category_mechanics_relationships: NPCs have daily schedules, gift preferences, personality traits and relationship levels. Higher relationships unlock special events, quests and marriage options.
category_advantages_relationships: Strong NPC relationships unlock exclusive quests, marriage options and social perks. Family members provide help with farming and business tasks.
category_weaknesses_relationships: Building relationships takes time and attention. Each NPC has different schedules and preferences that must be learned through observation and trial.
category_qt_relationships_0: Observe NPCs before giving gifts. Watch where they go and what they do to learn their preferences.
category_qt_relationships_1: Start building relationships early - high relationship levels take real in-game time to achieve.
category_qt_relationships_2: Consider personality traits when choosing a spouse - these affect your children's starting stats.

category_cards_crafting_1_subtitle: Gather resources from farming, mining, foraging and hunting.
category_cards_crafting_2_subtitle: Discover new recipes through experimentation and NPC hints.
category_intro_crafting: Master crafting in Kynseed with stations for cooking, alchemy, blacksmithing and more. Discover recipes and gather resources to craft powerful items.
category_mechanics_crafting: Crafting stations have quality tiers affecting output. Some recipes require rare ingredients discovered through exploration or purchased from NPCs.
category_advantages_crafting: Crafting provides powerful equipment and consumables. Self-crafted gear is often better than purchased alternatives.
category_weaknesses_crafting: High-tier crafting requires significant resource investment. Some rare materials only appear at specific times or locations.
category_qt_crafting_0: Upgrade crafting stations early - higher tier stations produce better quality items.
category_qt_crafting_1: Keep notes on recipe discoveries - some require specific ingredient combinations.
category_qt_crafting_2: Balance gathering time with other activities. Efficient resource management is key.

category_intro_dungeons: Explore dangerous dungeons in Kynseed filled with monsters and valuable loot. Each dungeon has unique enemies, traps and boss encounters.
category_mechanics_dungeons: Dungeons feature enemy waves, trap mechanics and puzzle elements. Boss fights require specific strategies and adequate preparation.
category_advantages_dungeons: Dungeons provide rare materials, powerful gear and significant gold rewards. Boss drops are essential for end-game equipment.
category_weaknesses_dungeons: Dungeon runs are dangerous without proper preparation. Death results in lost resources and potentially valuable items.
category_qt_dungeons_0: Always prepare before entering dungeons - bring healing items, food and appropriate equipment.
category_qt_dungeons_1: Learn enemy attack patterns before attempting boss fights. Practice makes perfect.
category_qt_dungeons_2: Save rare materials from dungeons for important crafting projects.

category_intro_lore: Discover the rich fairy tale world of Kynseed. Learn about the mysterious Kynseed, Thornborough's history, and the folklore-inspired creatures.
category_mechanics_lore: The lore connects to gameplay through the life cycle system and family legacy mechanics. Understanding the story enhances the experience.
category_advantages_lore: Lore knowledge enriches gameplay decisions and helps understand why certain mechanics work as they do.
category_weaknesses_lore: Some lore is fragmented across multiple sources. Complete understanding requires exploration and NPC conversations.
category_qt_lore_0: Talk to every NPC you meet - they all have unique stories and lore to share.
category_qt_lore_1: Read books and notes found throughout the world for deeper lore.
category_qt_lore_2: The Kynseed's true nature is revealed gradually - pay attention to hints.

category_mechanics_updates: Updates may add new features, balance changes, bug fixes and quality of life improvements. Check regularly for the latest changes.
category_advantages_updates: Staying informed about updates helps you adapt strategies and take advantage of new features quickly.
category_weaknesses_updates: Game balance may change with updates, potentially affecting existing strategies and guides.
category_qt_updates_0: Check for updates before starting major farming or crafting projects.
category_qt_updates_1: Save resources before major balance patches in case strategies change.
category_qt_updates_2: Report bugs you find through official channels to help improve the game.
